title: Protocol for PPP1R15A-inhibited mouse model establishment with subcutaneous B16F1 tumor and single-cell analysis
author: Wang, Wang, et al.
materials: 10× Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5′ Library & Gel Bead Kit v1.1
10× Genomics Chromium Single Cell 5′ Library Construction Kit
10× Genomics Chromium Single Cell V(D)J Enrichment Kit
10× Genomics Chromium Next GEM Chip G Single Cell Kit
10× Genomics Single Index Kit T Set A
Cell Activation Cocktail with Brefeldin A
MojoSort Mouse CD8 T Cell Isolation Kit
LIVE/DEAD Fixable Violet Dead Cell Stain Kit, for 405 nm excitation
LIVE/DEAD Fixable Near IR (780) Viability Kit, for 633 nm excitation

steps.title: Prepare Sephin1 and control solutions
steps.instruction: Warm DMSO and PBS in a 37 °C water bath for ~15 min. Dissolve 50 mg Sephin1 powder in 625 µL warm DMSO, then add to 12.5 mL warm PBS to obtain a 4 mg/mL Sephin1 solution containing 5 % DMSO. Prepare a control solution by mixing 2.5 mL DMSO with 47.5 mL PBS (5 % DMSO). Store both solutions at –20 °C for no longer than 3 months.

steps.title: Thaw and culture B16F1 cells
steps.instruction: Thaw a vial of cryopreserved B16F1 cells in a 37 °C water bath for 2–3 min, transfer to a 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min. Resuspend the pellet and seed into a 10 cm dish containing 10 mL RPMI‑1640 medium supplemented with 10 % FBS and 1 % Pen‑Strep. Passage the cells every other day, maintaining 4–6 × 10⁶ cells per dish. For each passage, digest cells with 2 mL TrypLE for 1 min at 37 °C, terminate digestion with 2 mL complete medium, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min, and reseed at a 1:3–1:4 ratio.

steps.title: Collect blood for PBMC isolation
steps.instruction: At Day 0 and Day 15, collect 100–200 µL peripheral blood from each mouse’s eye, mix with 200 µL EDTA, then add an equal volume of PBS. Measure the total volume and layer the mixture onto an equal volume of Ficoll‑Paque PREMIUM in a 15 mL centrifuge tube. Centrifuge at 18–20 °C, 400 × g for 20 min (acceleration = 5, deceleration = 3). Carefully collect the fluffy white PBMC layer at the interphase. If needed, lyse residual red cells with 1–2 mL ACK lysing buffer for 3 min at room temperature, add 10 mL PBS, centrifuge at 400 × g, 4 °C for 5–10 min, and wash once with PBS. Stain cells with AO/PI and count using a Cellometer K2 (or hemocytometer/trypan blue). Ensure viability > 70 % and ≥2 × 10⁵ live cells.

steps.title: Isolate tumor immune cells
steps.instruction: At Day 15, excise tumors, weigh each, and cut into 1–2 mm³ pieces. Digest the tissue with the Mouse Tumor Dissociation Kit (Miltenyi/MACS, cat 130‑096‑730) and filter the suspension through a 30 µm MACS SmartStrainer. Incubate cells with mouse CD45‑specific antibody (BioLegend, cat 157607) for 30 min, then add propidium iodide at a 1:100 ratio immediately before sorting. Sort CD45‑positive, live cells on a BD SORP FACSAria.

steps.title: Prepare single‑cell libraries
steps.instruction: Use the isolated single‑cell suspensions for 10× Chromium library construction following the manufacturers’ protocols. Required kits: Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5′ Library & Gel Bead Kit v1.1 (PN‑1000165, 16 rxns), Chromium Single Cell 5′ Library Construction Kit (PN‑1000020, 16 rxns), Chromium Single Cell V(D)J Enrichment Kit (Mouse T‑cell, PN‑1000071, 96 rxns), Chromium Next GEM Chip G Single Cell Kit (PN‑1000120, 48 rxns), and Single Index Kit T Set A (PN‑1000213, 96 rxns).

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence all libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq PE150 platform. Allocate 270 million clusters per gene‑expression library and 34 million clusters per TCR‑enriched library. Target ≥30 M reads per cell for expression data and ≥15 M reads per cell for TCR data.

steps.title: Run CellRanger count on expression data
steps.instruction:
Download the mouse reference dataset from https://cf.10xgenomics.com/supp/cell‑exp/refdata‑gex‑mm10‑2020‑A.tar.gz. For each sample, concatenate fastq files (R1 and R2) into processed_fastqs/. Then execute:
cellranger count --localcores=12 --id=<sample>_output --transcriptome=/data1/database/refdata‑cellranger‑mm10‑1.2.0 --fastqs=/data2/project/sephin_mouse_data/processed_fastqs/ --sample=<sample> --expect-cells=8000
using 12 CPU cores and an expected cell count of 8000.

steps.title: Run CellRanger vdj on TCR data
steps.instruction:
Download the V(D)J reference from https://cf.10xgenomics.com/supp/cell‑vdj/refdata‑cellranger‑vdj‑GRCm38‑alts‑ensembl‑7.0.0.tar.gz. For each sample, concatenate fastq files as above and execute:
cellranger vdj --localcores=12 --id=<sample>_output --reference=/path/to/vdj_reference --fastqs=/data2/project/sephin_mouse_data/processed_fastqs/ --sample=<sample>
using 12 CPU cores.

steps.title: Integrate expression data in Seurat
steps.instruction: In R, load Seurat 3.2.3, cowplot, future, Matrix. Set future.globals.maxSize = 1000000*1024^2. Import each sample, keep genes expressed in ≥2 cells, and retain cells with 100–4000 detected genes. Perform standard Seurat integration workflow (FindIntegrationAnchors, IntegrateData).

steps.title: AddModuleScore pathway analysis
steps.instruction:
Using Seurat’s AddModuleScore, calculate activity scores for the following gene sets (control gene numbers in parentheses):
- Cytotoxic regulation: Pnp, Cd1d1, Il12a, Il23a, Ptprc, H2‑T23, H2‑M3, H2‑K1, B2m, Tap1, Tap2, Il12b, P2rx7, Abcb9, H2‑D1, Xcl1 (ctrl = 20)
- Cytotoxic differentiation: Sart1, Hsp90aa1 (ctrl = 5)
- Cytotoxic effectors: Serpinb9, Gzmb, Ctsc, Ctsh (ctrl = 10)
Store the resulting scores as "Cytotoxic_Regulation_Signatures", "Cytotoxic_Diff_Regulation_Signatures", and "Cytotoxic_Signatures".

steps.title: Cell‑Chat communication analysis
steps.instruction:
Select five immune cell types: CD4+ T cells, NK cells, CD8+ T cells, Macrophages, DCs. Subset the integrated Seurat object to these clusters and save as "mouse_Tcell_NK_Mac_DC.rds". In R, load CellChat (v1.0.0) and ComplexHeatmap. For each sample (Normal_B_d0, Sephin1_B_d0, Normal_B_d15, Sephin1_B_d15, Normal_T_d15, Sephin1_T_d15):
1. createCellChat(subdata, group.by="Cluster_name")
2. identifyOverExpressedGenes() and identifyOverExpressedInteractions()
3. computeCommunProb(population.size=TRUE) with min.cells=10
4. computeCommunProbPathway()
5. aggregateNet()
Generate visualizations:
- netVisual_circle (edge.width.max = 20, arrow.size = 0.05, weight.scale=TRUE)
- netVisual_diffInteraction for each pair of normal vs. Sephin1 groups
- netVisual_bubble for selected pathways (e.g., APP, MIF, MHC‑I, SEMA4) focusing on NK & Cd8 interactions.
Export results as RDS files and PDFs as described.

steps.title: FACS analysis of tumor microenvironment
steps.instruction: Weigh each tumor and dissociate as in step 4. Stimulate the cell suspension (≈5 × 10⁶ cells/mL) with Cell Activation Cocktail + Brefeldin A (BioLegend, cat 423303) at a 1:500 cocktail‑to‑cell ratio for 4 h at 37 °C. Centrifuge 400 × g for 7 min and discard supernatant. Stain 30 min at 4 °C with the following antibodies (all at 1:200 dilution unless noted) and LIVE/DEAD Viability Kit (1:1000): CD45 (Thermo Fisher 12‑0451‑83; BioLegend 103105; BioLegend 157607), CD3E (BD Pharmingen 553064), CD4 (BioLegend 100548), CD8A (Thermo Fisher 25‑0081‑81), NK1.1 (Thermo Fisher 48‑5941‑80), FOXP3 (BioLegend 126419), PD‑1 (Thermo Fisher 17‑9985‑82), CD11b (BioLegend 101215), F4/80 (BioLegend 123125), TCRβ (BioLegend 109205). Use cell concentration ≤1 × 10⁸ cells/mL. Centrifuge 1500 rpm 5 min, wash with PBS. Fix/permeabilize with Cytofix/Cytoperm Kit (BD Pharmingen 554714) for 30 min at 4 °C, centrifuge 1500 rpm 5 min, discard supernatant. Incubate with IFN‑γ antibody (BioLegend 505806) at 1:200 for 30 min at 4 °C (cell concentration ≤1 × 10⁸ cells/mL). Wash and resuspend in BD Perm/Wash buffer. Acquire data on a CytoFLEX LX and apply the gating strategy: CD45⁺ → CD3E⁺/CD4⁺ or CD8A⁺ → NK1.1⁺ → CD4⁺FOXP3⁺ → CD8A⁺PD‑1⁺ → CD8A⁺IFN‑γ⁺.

steps.title: In‑vitro CD8+ T‑cell assay with Sephin1
steps.instruction: One day before use, coat round‑bottom 96‑well plates with 100 µL PBS containing 1 µg/mL anti‑mouse CD3ε (BioXCell BE0001‑1‑5MG) and anti‑mouse CD28 (BioXCell BE0015‑1‑5MG); discard the coating solution before adding cells. Isolate CD8⁺ T cells from spleens of 6–8‑week male C57BL/6 mice using the MojoSort Mouse CD8 T Cell Isolation Kit (BioLegend 480035). Label cells with the CFSE Cell Division Tracker Kit (BioLegend 423801) per manufacturer’s instructions. Resuspend cells in RPMI‑1640 (Gibco 11875093) supplemented with 10 % FBS (Biological Industries 04‑001‑1A) and 1 % Pen‑Strep (Gibco 15140122). Add mouse IL‑2 (Novoprotein CK24) and IL‑7 (Novoprotein CC73) to 20 ng/mL each and adjust cell density to 5 × 10⁵–1 × 10⁶ cells/mL. Incubate 72 h in the pre‑coated plates. Harvest cells by centrifugation at 400 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and stain 30 min at 4 °C with LIVE/DEAD Fixable Violet (Invitrogen L34963), PerCP/Cy5.5 anti‑mouse CD8a (BioLegend 100733), and PE anti‑mouse IFN‑γ (BioLegend 163503). Analyze on a CytoFLEX LX.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of results
steps.instruction: Perform all statistical analyses using GraphPad Prism 7 or R 3.6.3. Choose the appropriate test based on data distribution: unpaired two‑tailed Student’s t‑test, chi‑square test, or Wilcoxon test. Report exact p‑values or denote significance as * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001, **** p < 0.0001.
